hero.title: Structural Organisation in Animals
introParagraphs: In multicellular organisms, cells do not function in isolation. Similar cells work with intercellular substances to form tissues, which combine to create organs and organ systems.
From the diffusion boundary of lung alveoli to the electrical impulses coursing down motor axons, animal life operates through an exquisite division of labour across four primary tissue lineages.
